title: Versioning & Technical Documentation
subtitle: Post-Launch Stabilization — Engineering Release & Documentation Challenge
description: The product is live and business ROI is proven, but can engineering maintain, upgrade, and hand over the system without depending on original developers? Audit the messy repository, enforce Semantic Versioning (v1.0.0), publish enterprise developer portal specs, and enforce release governance.

stakeholders.name: Alex
stakeholders.agenda: Resolving scattered API docs, untracked configs, and establishing a single source of truth before the sprint closes.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing formal release versioning, backward compatibility contracts, and eliminating single points of human failure.

stakeholders.name: Sophia Bennett
stakeholders.agenda: Ensuring long-term product maintainability across 4,800 branches without vendor or developer dependency.

objectives.label: Audit messy engineering repository and eliminate unverified/duplicate technical files
Determine correct Semantic Versioning tag (v1.0.0) based on industry release standards
Publish comprehensive 6-domain architectural knowledge catalog to enterprise developer portal
Enforce strict release governance sign-off against short-term feature shortcut pressure
